text: For three days, the dish at Parkes had tracked Apollo eleven to the Moon, under clear skies.
asr: For three days, the dish at parks had tracked Apollo 11 to the moon under clear skies.

text: Then, on the day of the moonwalk, a storm came in.
The dish lay tipped to its limit, waiting for the Moon to rise.
Two gusts, over a hundred and ten kilometres an hour, slammed it against its gears.
asr: Two gusts, over 110 km an hour, slammed it against its gears.

text: At twelve fifty-four, the camera on the Moon switched on.
asr: At 1254, the camera on the moon switched on.

text: The first step reached the world through Honeysuckle Creek, near Canberra.
Minutes later, the Moon rose into the main beam, and Houston switched to Parkes.
asr: Minutes later the moon rose into the main beam and Houston switched to parks.

text: For the rest of the walk, the dish held on, outside its safety limits.
